oczekiwana_odpowiedz: We can treat this list as a sequence with a repetitive pattern. We see the sequence repeats itself every 24 elements (from 1 to 13 then back to 2). When 5000 is divided by 24, its remainder is 8. Therefore we see the $5000^{\text{th}}$ integer is the same as the $8^{\text{th}}$ integer, which is $\boxed{8}$.
